comparison.objective: Center a captive crossbar so its carrier can enter a low dock.
comparison.physical_skill: Sliding a captive member, then docking a constrained assembly.
comparison.success_condition: Crossbar centered, carrier fully docked, linkage consistent, stable, and both hands released.
comparison.reason: Captive-member centering and docking do not involve threaded adjustment, countertorque, or post-lock actuation.
